channel.title: GiveOwl – Christmas giveaways 2026
channel.description: Christmas-themed giveaways and sweepstakes from US brands for 2026: holiday trips, gift cards and Christmas prizes. Each one is checked against the sponsor's official rules. For everything in the holiday season, including Thanksgiving and Black Friday promotions, see the holiday sweepstakes page.

item.title: Tarte VIP 2026 Holiday Collection Giveaway – Tarte Cosmetics
item.description: Prize: Up to 7 winners each get a set of tarte 2026 Holiday Collection items. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Join tarte VIP for free (existing VIPs fill in the linked entry form) – one entry. US residents 18+

item.title: Nintendo NEW YORK My Nintendo Holiday Magic Sweepstakes – Nintendo of America
item.description: Prize: Two-night trip to Nintendo NEW YORK (travel Dec 3–7, 2026) for the winner and up to three guests: JetBlue base-fare travel certificate, hotel and a personal store tour. Deadline: November 2, 2026. Sign in with a free Nintendo Account and redeem 10 My Nintendo Platinum Points per entry (max 10). 18+, 48 contiguous states + DC

item.title: Turn the Page… Christmas Is Coming! Book Giveaway – Famadillo.com
item.description: Prize: 5 winners each get a copy of the children's advent book "Turn the Page… Christmas Is Coming!" ($10.99 each). Deadline: November 20, 2026. Fill in the form on the contest page; you may enter daily. USA

item.title: Elf Watch November Prize Draw (US) – Dubois Group Ltd (Elf Watch)
item.description: Prize: US$1,000 first prize + 10 Elf Watch Season Passes. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Sign up to the free Elf Tracker on elf.watch and invite friends with your link; when 3 friends have started the tracker you are entered. No purchase or app needed, 18+. Closes 29 November 2026 (23:59 UK time)

item.title: Dave & Sissy Christmas $30,000 Giveaway 2026 – Dave and Sissy Media LLC
item.description: Prize: $200 Amazon gift card to one subscriber in each morning and evening newsletter (Oct 5 – Dec 3); extra $500 gift card winners from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday, plus a third $500 email on Black Friday and Cyber Monday. Deadline: December 2, 2026. Sign up for the free newsletter and reply to the welcome email with your first and last name – one entry stays in every remaining drawing; bonus entry emails follow. US excl. NY & FL, 18+

item.title: The Toy Insider 2026 Room Full of Toys Holiday Sweepstakes – The Toy Insider (Adventure Media & Events)
item.description: Prize: One winner gets more than $1,000 worth of 2026's hottest toys; three runners-up each get a box of toys worth over $200. Deadline: December 4, 2026. Enter via the form on the giveaway page. US residents 18+

item.title: Peet's Home for the Holidays Giveaway – Peet's Coffee
item.description: Prize: 4 winners each get four Southwest e-passes – round-trip travel for the winner and a guest (ARV $800 each); weekly draws Nov 23, Nov 30, Dec 7 and Dec 14. Deadline: December 13, 2026. Fill in the online entry form (or email customerservice@peets.com). US residents 19+, excluding RI and TN

item.title: Clorox Catch Holiday 2026 Instant Win – The Clorox Company
item.description: Prize: 2 Clorox prize packs (ARV $137.74 each) + 100 instant-win cleaning products. Deadline: December 15, 2026. Play the game at clorox.com/lp/clorox-play and register; 1 play per day. 50 US + DC, 18+

item.title: Collegiate Power Movers Home for the Holidays Giveaway – Collegiate Power Movers
item.description: Prize: Breville Barista Express, outdoor pizza oven and 85" TV ($2,050). Deadline: December 20, 2026. Free entry by mail-in card (postmarked by Dec 13, 2026) or via the official Instagram/Facebook post; booking a move also gives entries. See the official rules

item.title: Hallmark Channel's Very Merry Giveaway Sweepstakes – Hallmark Media United States, LLC
item.description: Prize: Grand prize: 8-day/7-night Collette "Magical Christmas Markets of Austria and Germany" tour for 2 in 2027 plus $1,000 (ARV $10,398); also 103 prize packs across 71 daily entry periods. Deadline: December 25, 2026. Enter on the giveaway website once per day per available entry page. Residents of the 50 US states, DC and Puerto Rico, 21+

item.title: Hallmark Channel Countdown to Christmas Movie Game – Hallmark Media
item.description: Prize: $20,000 grand prize + Spoonful of Comfort gift card; weekly $1,000 prizes. Deadline: December 29, 2026. Register and play daily (trivia, polls, check-ins) to earn entries. 50 US + DC + PR, 18+. Ends Dec 29, 2026 08:59 ET

item.title: HGTV & Food Network Home for the Holidays Giveaway – Food Network / HGTV (Warner Bros. Discovery)
item.description: Prize: $5,000. Deadline: January 6, 2027. Enter twice daily – once on HGTV.com and once on FoodNetwork.com – until Jan 6, 2027 08:59 ET. US residents; check the official rules for the minimum age

item.title: Perdue Holiday Drop Sweepstakes – Perdue Farms
item.description: Prize: 5 winners each get a trip for two to an exclusive Perdue holiday dinner at Food Network Kitchen, New York (Dec 2, 2026), incl. airfare, plus a $1,750 Visa prepaid card (ARV $6,850 each). Deadline: November 6, 2026. From Oct 20 register at perdue.com/holiday-drop (mail-in entry also allowed). Legal residents of the 48 contiguous US states + DC

item.title: Macerich Shopping Center Holiday Sweepstakes – Macerich
item.description: Prize: $100,000 grand prize (check); 5 Nespresso coffee machines per participating mall ($229 each). Deadline: December 24, 2026. Fill in the entry form at shoppingcentersweepstakes.com and pick your mall; 1 entry per day. US 18+, must live within 100 miles of a participating Macerich center
